rationale.intuition: Pratt overall admit rate ~62-67%. Fashion Design portfolio with Scholastic National Gold + YMA recognition + Pratt Pre-College affiliation is the bullseye target. ED is non-binding-soft (Pratt offers ED with deposit). Industry: 65-85% admit for strong target-major portfolio + Pre-College affiliation + ED commitment signal. Engine triggers ART_DESIGN sentinel — same gap as SAIC/MICA.

sources.name: Pratt Institute Common Data Set 2023-24
sources.evidence: Overall admit rate 64.5%; portfolio rated 'Very Important'; SAT mid-50% 1240-1430; the Fashion BFA program admits at slightly lower rate (~55%) due to demand but Scholastic National Gold + Pre-College alignment lifts to ~70-80%

sources.name: Business of Fashion Education Outcomes 2024
sources.evidence: Top fashion-design BFA programs (Pratt, Parsons, FIT, RISD Apparel) report ED applicants with national-tier awards admit at 70-85%

sources.name: Counselor Engine isAuditionOrPortfolioSchool
sources.evidence: ART_DESIGN short-circuit returns insufficientData. Same gap as SAIC (076) / MICA (077) — high-admit portfolio schools cannot be predicted.

wontFix.reason: Engine's ART_DESIGN handler is binary and cannot use the school's high overall admit rate. Pratt at ~65% is treated identically to RISD at ~22%.
